description: The template for a given number of samples, with its positions already priced and the per-sample lines multiplied out. Give `samples` (and express: true for the express variant) or an exact `key`. If no tier matches, it returns NOTHING and names the tiers that exist — picking the nearest tier would be the expensive mistake here, because tiers differ by several hundred francs on the report alone. Lines whose price deviates from the customer's own template quotes are listed under abweichungen_vom_muster. The net total is a preview; the binding figure is computed by AbaNinja when the quote is created. Read-only.

key.description: Exact template key instead of choosing by sample count.

samples.description: Number of samples — decides the tier.

name: get_offer_template
